# HexPiece 3.6.6

The Mochi Awakening's whole set: press M, and every key is now its awakened move, each one built frame by frame on its reference GIF.
**Not tested in game yet:** the build and all 13 test suites pass, and every move was rendered in previews beside its GIF and fixed
until the frames matched.

## Power Mochi (V)
Two lumpy white donuts burst out of a splash of cream and a fireball, hanging head high at your sides for twenty seconds, each with a
soft red-orange glow round its edge and its black Haki fist in its hole. While they are out your left click is their punches, one donut
then the other: each fist shoots out of its donut as a thick black bar, as wide as the hole, with glowing orange seams along it and
flames licking off it, in a burst of fire (a fireball over the donut, crescents of fire either side, crimson splinters), and lands in a
puff of white dough. From behind, the donuts' holes look pale, as in the reference. In first person the donuts sit at the edges of your
view.

## Grilled Lance (Z, hold)
Mochi puffs round your hand, a ring of magenta Haki spins round your arm, a burst of black ink with magenta star flares, and your arm
swells into a great ball of cream mochi with magenta sparkles and fire at its base. Let go and it is driven into whoever is in front of
you: it bursts into fire burning in them while they are held there, explodes in rings of fire with rocks thrown, black Haki spikes stand
in them, and then it explodes again, far bigger: a white-hot flash, long rays and great swirls of fire.

## Elastic Lasso (X)
You whirl a lasso of mochi round you inside magenta rings and white wind, throw it in a burst of pink and black, and its thick white
band shoots out and loops round whoever you aim at; they are yanked back along it and land in front of you in a burst, held for a
moment so you can keep hitting them.

## Oblivion (C)
You stomp: cream mochi erupts at your feet and surges along the ground to whoever is in front of you, rising into jagged walls all round
them that hold them; the walls sag and break, black spikes and pink streaks stand in them, and it all bursts in a star of black and
magenta that blows cream shards everywhere.

## Blazing Storm (B)
Six arms of mochi sprout from your back into white puffs, and six black Haki arms batter the place you aim at over and over, wrapped in
streaks of fire; it follows where you look. Then all six strike at once and it explodes.

## Scorching Buzz Cut (N, hold)
Hold N: you become a burning white wheel with black spikes, fire spraying off the ground behind you, rolling over and burning whoever
you meet. Let go: they are caught on your arm, now a giant spiked ball on fire, whirled round you in a ring of fire and magenta Haki
with a column of fire rising, and slammed down in a far bigger, burning blast. Five minutes to come back.

With the Conqueror's Haki and Ryou on, every one of these throws the Conqueror's lightning, out of their explosions where they have one.
